description: Latest price for one fertilizer product from USDA MARS production cost reports (Illinois-led regional coverage) — the same series get_fertilizer_history extends over time. Use for a current input-cost quote; use get_spreads instead to relate fertilizer cost to corn or cattle prices. Read-only lookup of stored reports; no API key. The reports publish twice a month and are fetched on the 1st and 15th, so the latest price can be up to about two weeks old; returns the price, its unit (typically USD per ton), and the change versus the prior report.
name: get_fertilizer_price
